description:
The current Plug uses:
  - :gen_tailscale_socket.start_loopback(socket) → {address, proxy_cred, local_api_cred}
  - :gen_tailscale_socket.getremoteaddr(socket) → remote IP

These need to be replaced with ts_elixir equivalents.

For remote IP:
  - GenTailscale.peername(socket) should work directly

For user info (whois):
  - ts_elixir has Tailscale.peer_by_tailnet_ip(dev, ip) which could replace the LocalAPI whois call
  - OR keep the LocalAPI approach if ts_elixir adds loopback support
  - Need to investigate what peer_by_tailnet_ip returns vs the LocalAPI whois response

Also need to update the adapter pattern match — currently digs into
Bandit adapter internals to find the gen_tailscale socket.
title: Update TailscaleTransport.Plug for new backend
